jobs.prompt:
Subject: A cozy community hall seen from the side. Small round tables, each with a few simple faceless people chatting around it (a hobby table with yarn and a camera, a small-shop table with parcels, a study table with notebooks). One friendly indie maker sits at a table, leaning in to help someone, pointing at a laptop screen that shows a simple tidy picture only. Above the tables float soft speech bubbles containing small icons (a question mark, a lightbulb, a heart). From the maker's table a thin dotted path leads out of an open door on the right to the maker's tiny shop with a warm lit window and a gift box on the step; two small visitors walk along the path. A small notice board by the door with blank paper notes (house rules).
